learning_outcomes.text: Students can evaluate the material groups metals, polymers, ceramics, and composites regarding their mechanical properties by analyzing their structure (microstructure) and the influence of manufacturing and heat treatment on the microstructure (e.g., using phase diagrams) and applying material testing methods, in order to select materials for engineering applications in design and manufacturing in subsequent courses and professional life.

syllabus_topics: Material classes, material selection and sustainability aspects
Structure of materials: bonding types; atomic arrangement, lattice defects
Properties of materials: physical and mechanical properties
Material testing: tensile test, hardness test, fatigue test, non-destructive testing
Thermally activated processes: diffusion, recovery and recrystallization, creep
Alloy theory: phase diagrams for binary systems, practical examples
Introduction to polymers: manufacturing, classification, structure

assessment_methods.method: Presentation (20 min) or laboratory report or written assignment

assessment_rules: The grade for MECB150 is calculated from the grade for MECB151 (written exam). MECB152 (referate/lab report/written assignment) is an ungraded study achievement, defined at the beginning of the semester.
bibliography: Werkstoffkunde, Bargel, H.-J. und Schulze, G., aktuelle Auflage, Springer Verlag
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Mechatronik (B.Eng.)
